title: Optimized Bubble Sort
statement:
Plain bubble sort always performs all `n - 1` passes, even if the array becomes sorted early. The **optimized** version tracks whether a pass swapped anything and stops as soon as a pass makes no swaps, because that means the array is already sorted.

Given an array `a` of `n` integers, run this optimized bubble sort into non-decreasing order:

- Passes are numbered `i = 0, 1, ..., n - 2` (so there are at most `n - 1` passes).
- In pass `i`, look at the adjacent pairs `(a[j], a[j+1])` for `j = 0, 1, ..., n - 2 - i`, in this order. If `a[j] > a[j+1]`, swap them (equal elements are never swapped).
- If pass `i` made **no** swaps, stop right after it. That final pass still counts as a pass.
- If `n = 1`, no pass is performed.

Print the number of passes performed, the total number of swaps over all passes, and the sorted array.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
The second line contains `n` space-separated integers, the elements of `a`.
outputFormat: Print three lines: the number of passes performed, the total number of swaps, and the `n` sorted elements separated by spaces.

examples.explanation: Pass 0 makes 3 swaps (5 moves to the end: 1 4 2 5). Pass 1 makes 1 swap (4,2: 1 2 4 5). Pass 2 makes no swaps, so it is counted and the algorithm stops: 3 passes, 4 swaps.
The very first pass finds nothing to swap, so the optimized version stops after 1 pass.
A single element needs no passes.

complexity.time: O(n^2) worst case, O(n) when already sorted

hints: Keep a boolean flag that is reset at the start of every pass and set to true whenever you swap.
After a pass finishes, check the flag: if no swap happened, break out of the outer loop, but count that pass first.
Do not run more than n - 1 passes, and shrink the inner loop by one each pass since the largest elements have settled at the end.

        s = sorted(rng.randint(-30, 30) for _ in range(n))

        s[i], s[i + 1] = s[i + 1], s[i]
        tests.append(fmt(s))

    tests.append(fmt(s))
    s2 = s[:]
    s2[0], s2[1] = s2[1], s2[0]
